properties.name: spring.courier.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether Micrometer metrics instrumentation is enabled. Defaults to true when micrometer-core is on the classpath.

properties.name: spring.courier.slack.webhook-url
properties.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL. When set, enables built-in Slack alerting.

properties.name: spring.courier.slack.app-name
properties.description: Display name for the application in alert messages.

properties.name: spring.courier.slack.enabled
properties.description: Whether Slack alerting is enabled. Requires webhook-url to be set.

properties.name: spring.courier.slack.evaluation-interval-seconds
properties.description: How often (in seconds) alert rules are evaluated. Must be between 10 and 3600.

properties.name: spring.courier.slack.cooldown-minutes
properties.description: Minimum minutes between repeated alerts for the same rule. Must be between 1 and 1440.

properties.name: spring.courier.slack.for-duration-seconds
properties.description: How long (in seconds) a condition must hold before firing.
